title: Cookie set without the Secure flag
description: A Set-Cookie response lacks the Secure flag, so the browser may send the cookie over unencrypted HTTP where network attackers can steal it.
remediation: Add the Secure flag to every cookie (and HttpOnly unless JavaScript must read it). Cookies are evaluated one entry per Set-Cookie header value.
limitation: One header value counts as one cookie: a folded multi-cookie single value may under-flag. Responses that set no cookies never match.
